content: sqlite-vec 0.1.9 stable provides a vec0 virtual table (float/int8/binary, cosine/L2) registered via sqlite3_auto_extension with rusqlite bundled, passing vectors as bytes via zerocopy 0.8.59; it is the standard fix for the workspace brute-force full-table-scan cosine search and removes any need for the unbuildable LanceDB/SurrealDB backends crate.
